a1: Designing a home? It usually takes weeks of back and forth, before you even see one plan.
a2: Arch Adapt A.I. is different. A regular chatbot can describe a house for you, but it can't check if it's actually buildable.
a3: Ours builds the plan from rules. Setbacks, stairs, circulation. So every plan is validated, never generic.
b1: You start with a simple choice. Are you building a home, or are you an architect? Two ways in.
b2: As a homeowner, you just enter your plot, the rooms you need, and pick a style.
b3: There are optional extras too, and you can leave a note for the A.I., so the design fits your family.
c1: And out comes a scaled floor plan, checked against the rules.
c2: Want a change? Just ask, and it becomes a new version. Then take a look in three-D.
c3: Export to CAD, three-D, or spreadsheets. Arch Adapt A.I. Plans that fit.
